cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Warm, calm and respectful throughout, with an honest, non-defensive answer when the caller doubted the outage start time. Mostly English-led Taglish with natural 'po' and 'Opo', though a few lines drift into more Tagalog ('Verified na po kayo', 'Kung mas maaga po talagang nawala ang internet niyo'), and the outage reply runs a bit long.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Hello po, thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber! I'm Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po, Tala. Si Maria Santos po ito, taga-Batasan Hills, Quezon City. Wala po kasing internet namin simula kaninang umaga. Pwede ko po bang malaman kung bakit at kailan babalik?

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that po, Ma'am. Para ma-check ko po, can I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, ang account number ko po ay 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number na naka-register, 0101 po.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you po. Let me verify your account first.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Ma'am Maria. Let me check your area for outages now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Opo Ma'am, there's an outage in Batasan Hills caused by a fiber cable cut along Batasan Road during road works. It started at around 3:42 PM today, and service is expected back by around 10:12 PM tonight. Gusto niyo po ba ng reference number for follow-up?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ah, ganun po ba. Pero kaninang umaga pa po talaga wala kaming internet, bago mag-tanghali. Sigurado po ba kayong 3:42 PM nagsimula? Baka po magkaiba yung nakikita niyo sa outage na yan.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Yes po, the outage record shows 3:42 PM, and I don't see an earlier one for your area. Kung mas maaga po talagang nawala ang internet niyo, I can't explain that on this call, and I have no tool to check your line itself.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ay sige po, naiintindihan ko. Baka po iba lang yung nauna, pero okay na po sa akin na alam ko yung dahilan at kung kailan babalik, mga 10:12 PM po. Sige po, pakibigay na lang yung reference number. Maraming salamat po, Tala. Paalam na po!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Opo Ma'am, the reference number is O, U, T, then 2026, then 0412. Walang anuman po, salamat po sa pagtawag sa Kidlat Fiber, ingat po!
